title: Finite type algebra with finite spectrum is finite-dimensional
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $B$ be a commutative $k$-algebra of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. If $\operatorname{Spec} B$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] has finitely many prime ideals, then every prime ideal of $B$ is maximal, $B$ is finite-dimensional as a $k$-vector space, and $\operatorname{Spec} B$ is a finite discrete space. The zero ring is allowed.
